baseline: existing online_provenance_runs/history; exact same6s prefix/source and runtime state required
change: one post-act local radial observed-hazard stopping veto; no planner/reference/PID/gain/cap/mapping/latch/rig/label change
empirical_tail_source: max bank/forward/reverse existing12s finite observation stopping path, not universal bound
unknown: never free; counted, permitted under exact old exploration cap. No full3D collision certificate
higher_speed: mark empirical scope exceeded; do not infer validated stopping bound. No extra speed threshold/scan
veto: nonzero proposed block and at least one observed occupied cell within radial envelope; final raw block zero, existing rollPID/smoother unchanged; zero request not actual stopped
stop_qualification: diagnostic only: five consecutive10Hz actual XY samples<.05, rebound resets count; does not change original direction latch
evaluation: same frozen independent E1reference, physical contact,actual path/goal/ref progress/cross RMS peak; log proposed/final action. Parking or delayedfailure not navigation success
acceptance: component: observed hazards actually veto final requests, causal exact pre-divergence physical/action/observer histories, no hidden inputs/map writes. Navigation: goal reached withoutcontact in35s; otherwise reject reliable navigation. Safety signal separately if contact prevented; no claim improvement merely from stalled progress
budget: one actual candidate E1run, no threshold sweep and no formal E0/E1/E2 admission
